600517.SS.longBusinessSummary: State Grid Yingda Co.,Ltd. engages in the trust, securities, futures, carbon assets, and power equipment businesses in China and internationally. It offers electrical distribution transformers, amorphous iron cores, integrated substations, integrated primary and secondary equipment, C-GIS, gas-filled switchgear, surge arresters, AC and DC bushings, insulated towers, nano-aluminum alloy fittings, insulators, lightning monitoring, and warning technology services. The company also provides intelligent power grid operation and maintenance services and low-carbon energy-saving solutions; engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) of power transmission and distribution projects, new energy projects, high-voltage testing and inspection, and laboratory engineering activities. In addition, it is involved in the trust activities; securities business, such as brokerage and credit, proprietary investment, investment banking, asset management, and co-investment businesses; futures business activities; and carbon audit, carbon asset development, carbon finance, carbon trading, low-carbon and carbon market-related research topics, and green supply chain management activities. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Zhixin Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to State Grid Yingda Co.,Ltd. in April 2020. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China. State Grid Yingda Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of State Grid Yingda International Holdings co.,LTD.

600519.SS.longBusinessSummary: Kweichow Moutai Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells liquor products in China and internationally. The company offers liquor and soy sauce products under the Kweichow Moutai, Moutai Wangzi liquor, Moutai 1935 liquor, Han Jiang liquor, and Lai Mao liquor brands. It also engages in the production and sale of beverage, food, and packaging materials; development of anti-counterfeiting technology; research and development of information industry related products; operation and management of hotel, accommodation, catering, entertainment, bathing, and parking lot services; and provision of vehicle transportation and maintenance, and value-added telecommunication services. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Renhuai, China. Kweichow Moutai Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China Kweichow Moutai Distillery(Group)Co,.Ltd.

600522.SS.longBusinessSummary: Jiangsu Zhongtian Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells electrical machinery and equipment for the communications, electric power, marine, new energy, marine engineering construction, and other business sectors in China and internationally. It provides telecommunication products, including PON, optical fiber cables, Fttx, coaxial cables, antennas, telecom power systems, optical transceivers, and micro modular data center products; and submarine cables comprising medium voltage, HVAC, and HVDC submarine cables, as well as EPIC, submarine fiber optic cables, and accessories. The company also offers hardware fittings, insulators, arresters, OPGW, conductors, aluminum-clad steel wires, transformers, and power switch gears, as well as LV, MV, and HV power cables; lithium-ion batteries, solar cell back sheets, and photovoltaic technology; and new materials and components, including 3D printing, supercapacitors, open cell aluminum foam, and polyimide films. In addition, it engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction activities; and non-ferrous metal trading and other business activities. Jiangsu Zhongtian Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is based in Nantong, the People's Republic of China.

600535.SS.longBusinessSummary: Tasly Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceuticals in China. The company offers prescription drugs covering various therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular-cerebrovascular, tumor immunity, digestion and metabolism, and neuroscience; over-the-counter drugs; modern TCM; biological drugs; and chemical drugs. It also engages in medical instruments, agriculture, and chain drugstore activities. The company was formerly known as Tianjin Tasly Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tasly Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd in May 2012. Tasly Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Tianjin, China.

600536.SS.longBusinessSummary: China National Software & Service Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides basic software and core application solutions in China and internationally. The company offers Galaxy Kylin desktop, Galaxy Kylin advanced server, and Starlight Kylin operating systems; and DM8 database management system, DM distributed database, database appliance DAMENG PAI, Dameng Qiyun database cloud service system, and GDMBASE. It also provides waterproof dam data leakage prevention, host monitoring and auditing, unified endpoint security management, printing and CD burning security monitoring and auditing, network access control, terminal security login and file protection, and electronic document security management systems, as well as consulting services for the protection of trade secrets of central state-owned enterprises; and communication power and environmental monitoring system. In addition, the company offers core applications for organization, taxation, railway, electricity, water conservancy, enterprise, and common application services; and operation support, application building, data service, and artificial intelligence platforms. Further, it engages in application software operations; computer system business; development and sale of computer software and hardware; research, development, production, and sale of core modules for automated ticketing systems; technical activities; software and information technology operations; information systems and integration business; and business operations. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Beijing, China.

600546.SS.longBusinessSummary: Shanxi Coal International Energy Group Co.,Ltd engages in the coal production business in China. It offers raw coal and power coal; and trades in thermal, cooking, anthracite, and semi-anthracite coal products. The company also engages in production, washing, sales, trade, and transportation services; and sourcing and warehousing services, as well as coal mining; general waterway cargo transportation; ship inspection services; domestic ship management; and import and export business. It serves steelmaking enterprises and power plants industries. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Taiyuan, China. Shanxi Coal International Energy Group Co.,Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Shanxi Coal Import & Export Group Co., Ltd.

600547.SS.longBusinessSummary: Shandong Gold Mining Co., Ltd. engages in mining, smelting, processing, and precious metals in the People's Republic of China. It explores for silver, copper, iron, lead, and zinc metals. The company is also involved in manufacturing special equipment for gold mines; gold and non-ferrous metal mining and smelting; and building decoration materials, as well as invests in gold bars. In addition, it offers ecological restoration and environmental protection, investment and asset management, construction engineering, futures brokerage, and consulting and investigation services. Shandong Gold Mining Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Jinan, the People's Republic of China.

600549.SS.longBusinessSummary: Xiamen Tungsten Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale of tungsten, molybdenum, rare earth, battery materials, and other industrial products in China. 600562.SS.longBusinessSummary: Glarun Technology Co.,Ltd operates in the computer, communication, and other electronic equipment manufacturing industry in China and internationally. The company offers radar equipment and related systems products for international operations, military electronics, public meteorology, emergency management, transportation, water conservancy, and power. It also provides industrial software and digital solutions products, such as automatic train protection system, automatic train control, data communication system, NGTT-1A type 3-out-of-2 secure computer platform, tram operation and dispatch system, intersection control system, turnout control system, vehicle control system, obstacle detection system, modern tram automatic control system, PIS passenger information system, and stacking machine. 600563.SS.longBusinessSummary: Xiamen Faratronic Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells film capacitors and metallized coating materials in China and internationally. The company provides film capacitors, such as SMD, polyethylene naphtalate, polyester, polypropylene, interference suppression, precision, and capacitive divider A.C. capacitors for PCB applications. It offers film capacitors for power electronics; AC motor capacitors; capacitors for lamps; and metalized polyester and polypropylene films. Xiamen Faratronic Co., Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.

600566.SS.longBusinessSummary: Hubei Jumpcan Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of medicines in China.
